_comment: Durable rolling journal for the Night Hawk 0DTE forensic lane. Read via `git show origin/main:docs/audit/nighthawk-0dte-live-journal.json` at the start of every firing — never trust a stale local copy. Update in place and commit+push directly to main (state file, no PR, same pattern as .blackout-agent/HEARTBEAT). Prune sessions older than ~2 trading days. Cold start on 2026-09-10 — no prior continuity existed before this file.

CIFR.note: coherent: real gex-walls thesis-break ~69s after entry, cortex decision/narrative agree. No finding.

SHOP.note: instant (1.7s) self-veto, narrative says BLOCKED but decision=PASS/vetoes=[]. Pre-dates PR #4656 fix (merged 16:43:45 UTC same day). Explained, not a new finding.

MSTR.note: same instant-self-veto shape as SHOP, same batch tick, pre-#4656. Explained.

LUNR.note: 22min hold, real thesis_break, coherent. No finding.

ENPH.note: WINNER, exit management verified coherent: peak 18% never reached trim_scale's 20% first-trim trigger, so trims correctly never fired; universal profit-floor locked +5% instead of round-tripping to red. Not mismanagement.

ASTS.note: instant (0.16s) self-veto shape, pre-#4656 (fix merged 16:43:45 UTC same day, this play is ~1hr before). Explained.

QQQ.note: OPEN FINDING — see open_findings[0]. Phantom stale-entry-price stop, NOT a real 51% move. entry_premium(1.76)==flow_avg_fill, but real Polygon 1-min bars show the option was only near $1.76 ~51min earlier (~15:23 UTC); by commit (16:14:39 UTC) it had already decayed to ~0.82-0.97 on a flat underlying. Reported to PR #4076, not fixed (touches live entry-pricing/grading logic).

ASTS.note: coherent: peak never left +/-10% band in 32min, cut for a small scratch loss. No mechanical finding. Score 65 == score_floor exactly (marginal pass) -- single data point, log for future score_floor correlation, do NOT escalate alone (noise-discipline threshold is 3+).

open_findings.summary: entry_premium falls back to stale flow_avg_fill (no fresh option quote required) when planEntryMax is null; CHASE_PCT no-chase guard (55%) is wider than the play's own hard stop (-50%), so a 'not chasing' entry can already be past its own stop the instant a fresh mark is taken at commit. Produced a mechanically-false 'stopped -51.42%' 0.91s after entry -- verified against real Polygon bars, not a real market move.
root_cause_files: src/lib/zerodte/gates.ts:1730-1736 (liveCommitPreconditionsUnmet quote_age_unknown -- didn't catch this one, untraced why)
open_findings.next_step_if_asked: pull full population of FLOW-origin plays where entry_premium==flow_avg_fill AND input_age_manifest.option_quote==null to size blast radius before any fix is decided

known_explained_patterns.pattern: instant (<4s) thesis_break exit with cortex narrative saying 'BLOCKED by 1 veto' while decision=PASS/vetoes=[]
known_explained_patterns.note: applyCortexCommitRelief strips a veto at commit when Vector confirms direction; live exit-time thesis check recomposed evidence fresh with no memory of the relief and immediately fired thesis_break. All 4 instances observed in the 2026-09-09 ledger (SHOP, MSTR, RKLB, ASTS) are timestamped BEFORE the fix merged -- consistent with, not contradicting, the fix. Watch for a recurrence AFTER 2026-09-09T16:43:45Z on a future cycle; that would mean the fix has a gap.
